content: linearmodels.PanelOLS is the standard Python tool for fixed-effects panel regression, extending statsmodels. Data must be shaped as a MultiIndex DataFrame (entity, time) before fitting; entity_effects=True (and optionally time_effects=True) implements country/year fixed effects via demeaning. Standard workflow: build panel MultiIndex -> fit PanelOLS with clustered standard errors -> use Hausman test to justify fixed vs random effects choice -> report diagnostics (serial correlation, heteroskedasticity, cross-sectional dependence) alongside coefficients. This model class is a linear model, not a black-box estimator.
